records.reason: A Strike activity whose entire payload is conditions and penalties applied to the TARGET; nothing changes on the gunslinger's own sheet.

Real self-facing mechanic: the character's own frightened/stupefied values drop by 2 instead of 1 each time they would decrease. No field expresses a change to condition-value recovery rate, and situational only carries numeric check bonuses.
Only removes the cover/concealment requirement for Hide and Sneak in a chosen terrain; no sheet number or proficiency changes and cover state is table-adjudicated.
Only removes the cover/concealment requirement for Hide and Sneak in natural terrain; permission to use an action, not a sheet value.
Same as the misspelled duplicate: lifts the cover/concealment requirement on Hide and Sneak in the selected terrain; no sheet statistic involved.
A two-action activity resolved at the table: HP regained and the counteract bonus both depend on the level of whichever invested item is drained at that moment, so there is no static value to record.
Reshapes a siege weapon's area (burst to line and back) during play; area geometry is GM/table-side and the app does not model siege firing areas on the character sheet.
An action whose effects are a Reflex save and damage against the ENEMY landed on; the character's own falling damage follows the normal rules.

Grants an actual climb Speed of 15 feet while moving through foliage, plus a critical-success upgrade on Climb/Balance in trees and off-guard immunity while doing so. The speed is a real sheet value with no delivery; it is terrain-conditional, so it belongs in a toggleable mode rather than an always-on speeds field.

mode.name: Canopy Predator
mode.duration: while moving through trees, vines, and other foliage
mode.note: A success on an Athletics check to Climb a tree or an Acrobatics check to Balance on a branch is a critical success instead, and you aren't off-guard while Climbing or Balancing on a tree.

records.reason: Everything it does happens on the other side of the table: enemies' Point Out and Seek attempts fail or misplace you. No statistic of the character changes.

A permanent defensive upgrade to the character's own saves: success becomes critical success against disease and poison (and critical failure becomes failure if stacked with Battle Hardened). Degree-of-success upgrades have no field — situational only carries numeric bonuses.

Grants two additional cantrips from the matching tradition — a real spellcasting resource the player should be able to PICK. spellSlotBonus cannot deliver it: build.ts filters slot grants to ranks > 0, so rank-0 (cantrip) counts are unreachable, and no other field expresses a cantrip-count increase.

Two extra cantrips prepared per day (prepared casters) or two extra cantrips added to the repertoire (spontaneous) — a picked spellcasting resource. Same missing lane as Cantrip Casting: spellSlotBonus explicitly skips rank 0, so nothing can grant cantrip capacity.
Extends how long the GROUP can Hustle in exploration mode — a travel/exploration-pace rule the app does not model, and it affects the party rather than the character's sheet.
Grants a GM-rolled trap-detection check while not Searching; exploration-mode adjudication with no sheet statistic.
Positioning only — the swarm carries you as it Strides. Movement/positioning is resolved at the table and grants no speed or other sheet value.
A reaction that lets you Step up to 10 feet; an action resolved at the table with no persistent statistic change.
A follow-up spell attack that deals damage to a NEW target after a Spellstrike; nothing on the magus's own sheet changes.
A spellshape that knocks the TARGET prone and can penalize the target's Speed; entirely target-side.

After Divine Castigation, the character's own weapon and unarmed Strikes gain the holy/unholy trait and extra spirit damage until end of turn — a real change to the player's Strike line. No lane exists: modes carry only fixed numeric modifiers, and this rider's value equals the rank of the harm/heal that was cast, plus a trait grant no field can express.
A reaction Strike that grabs or slows the triggering creature; effects land on the target, and the multiple-attack-penalty exemption is a per-action rule resolved when the Strike is rolled.

The legacy APG version of a crit-spec grant its own prerequisite already delivers: core.json's catfolk-weapon-familiarity carries critSpec:true, critSpecLevel:5 and critSpecWeapons {traits:['catfolk'], bases:['kama','kukri','scimitar','sickle']} — exactly this feat's effect for any character eligible to take it.
Lets you converse with and use Diplomacy on herd animals, with the GM deciding which animals qualify; pure roleplay/GM adjudication, no sheet statistic.

A crafting/daily-preparation ability: formulas learned and temporary oils and potions brewed each day. The app has no formula-book lane and the created consumables are just inventory items the player adds; nothing derives from the feat itself.
A Strike plus an immediate flat check to end persistent bleed on yourself or an ally; a table-rolled flat check with no persistent sheet value.
A free action that lets you cast shield when its cooldown would forbid it; the shield spell and its AC bonus already exist, and this only changes when you may cast it.
Removes the cover/concealment requirement for Hide and Sneak and upgrades cover degree; cover is table state the app does not track and no sheet statistic changes.
A three-action area attack: fire and sonic damage plus difficult terrain against creatures in a cone. All effects are target- and battlefield-side.

A permanent, always-on change to the character's own attacks: all weapon and unarmed Strikes gain the holy and magical traits (which drives weaknesses and damage-type interactions on the Strikes page). No field adds traits to existing Strikes — grantedStrikes only creates new ones.

A death-triggered reaction that restores Hit Points and reduces wounded during play; current-HP and condition changes are entered through the sheet's HP control at the table, not derived from a static field.
A daily-preparation ritual that turns a mundane dagger into a wand-like item; the resulting knife is tracked as an inventory item with charges, and the feat itself confers no sheet statistic.

Grants the character resistance equal to half their level to a player-chosen physical damage type against the next Strike after using Ceremony of Protection — a real defensive value. No lane fits: an always-on resistances field would massively over-grant, and a mode cannot carry a pick-one-of-three damage type for a single-Strike, one-round window.

The character constantly has the effects of Enlarge (Large size, +5 feet reach, +2 status bonus to melee damage, clumsy 1), dismissable and resumable as an action. That is a stack of real sheet changes with no delivery; the size/reach lanes are always-on only and cannot be combined with the clumsy penalty and the dismiss/resume toggle.

Adds the deadly d8 trait to the character's claws unarmed attack and shove/trip to their branch unarmed attack — real changes to Strike lines the sheet renders. No field modifies the traits of an already-granted unarmed Strike.
Only changes the dice rolled by another ability (Sunlight Healing recovers 1d8 per level); healing is rolled and applied at the table, not a derived sheet statistic.
Legacy duplicate of Ceremony of Strengthened Hand: adds deadly d8 to claws and shove/trip to branch unarmed attacks. Same missing lane — nothing can amend the traits of an existing unarmed Strike.

A miss rider: half Strategic Strike damage on a missed Devise a Stratagem attack. The amount is half a value the sheet already shows and it applies only to a rolled outcome, so nothing static changes.
Misspelled duplicate of Certain Stratagem; same miss-damage rider resolved when the Strike is rolled, derived from the strategic strike damage the sheet already displays.
Adds a failure effect to one Strike (damage minus all damage dice); an outcome rule applied when the attack is rolled, not a change to any sheet value.
Chains an Elemental Blast between targets, rolling damage once; entirely target-side attack sequencing resolved at the table.
A chain of Strikes against successive enemies; all effects land on targets and the sequence is resolved at the table.
Delivered: the core.json record already carries maxHpBonus {"perArchetypeFeat":3,"archetype":"champion"}, so the sheet gains 3 HP per champion archetype feat automatically.

Grants the champion reaction tied to the character's chosen cause (retributive-strike / glimpse-of-redemption / liberating-step all exist as classFeatures in core.json), but nothing wires the feat to them. grantedFeatId/grantsFeats reference FEATS only, so there is no lane to grant a class feature, nor to key that grant off the cause picked at Champion Dedication.
Removes the disguise-kit requirement for Impersonate and adds the occult trait to that activity; an equipment/trait note on a table-resolved skill activity, with no bonus or sheet value.
Only widens which of your own weapons Accursed Touch applies to; the underlying effect is a curse applied to the creature you hit and is resolved at the table.
An action that spends a Harm or Heal slot to damage the TARGET with a Strike; the spell and its damage already exist and no statistic of the cleric changes.
Raises a shield's Hardness by 1d8 per spell rank for a single Shield Block, at the cost of a spell slot; a rolled, per-use value rather than a standing shield statistic.
A spellshape that randomizes a spell's damage type and adds a rider condition to each creature DAMAGED by it; all effects are target-side.
Lets line and cone spells originate from your persistent creation; a targeting/geometry permission resolved on the battle map, with no sheet value.
A two-action attack: the frightened target saves against your existing class or spell DC and takes persistent spirit damage. Entirely target-side; the DCs it uses are already on the sheet.
A reaction that keeps you at 1 HP and inflicts doomed 1 on yourself; current HP and conditions are tracked in play at the table, not derived from a field.

Relaxes the free-hand requirement for Dirty Trick and lets you drop a weapon to downgrade a critical failure; action requirements and outcome downgrades resolved at the table, with no sheet statistic.
A storage quirk — four light-Bulk items held in the mouth, retrieved with Interact actions. Flavour and inventory handling; no bonus, capacity formula, or sheet value the engine computes.

Explicitly grants a named ability the character should own and see: the toxicologist's Greater Field Discovery, which exists in core.json as the classFeature greater-field-discovery-toxicologist. Nothing links them, and no field grants a CLASS FEATURE (grantedFeatId/grantsFeats take feat ids only).
Trades Fireball damage for a lingering Stinking Cloud in the spell's area; a per-cast modification whose effects land on creatures in the area.
A two-action Medicine activity that gives an ALLY an assisted recovery from persistent damage at range; the benefit is entirely on the target's side.

A permanent self-facing defensive change: the character's own flat-check DC to recover from persistent acid, bleed and poison damage is 10 instead of 15. Nothing delivers it — situational carries numeric check bonuses only, and no field alters a persistent-damage recovery DC.
Changes where the banner may be planted and forces enemies who attack it to save against your existing class DC; battlefield placement plus target-side saves.
A reaction to Strike or Stride toward the triggering enemy, possibly making it off-guard; an action resolved at the table with all effects on the enemy.
A fortune reaction to reroll a failed Deception or Performance check and take the second result; a reroll permission, not a bonus or sheet value.
